label: L=9 early copy steps (outputs 1-2), mostly when echoed input is v
explanation: Very sparse unit (0.03% of steps). Fires only in the copy phase, about 99.6% of mass in L=9 sequences, at t=10/11 (recall_idx 1 or 2, i.e. the input is the echoed orig(0) or orig(1)). Never fires in the original or delimiter phases, or at later copy steps. Within that context it fires on only ~1% of steps (context predicate: recall 0.96, mass recall 0.97, precision 0.01). The strongest modulator is the echoed input token: v gives 58% of mass and the top activations (first_tok=v is 7.9x lift), followed by y, e, k, m, u. Even with v, only ~16% of eligible steps fire, and I found no further token condition (out_tok, later tokens) that separates them, so the exact gating looks combinatorial in the sequence contents.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=v (+4.40), phase=2 & in_tok=y (+2.95), phase=2 & in_tok=k (+2.62), phase=2 & in_tok=e (+2.55), L=9 & t=10 (+2.26), L=9 & t=11 (+2.21). Lower it: orig8=- (-3.20), next_out=- (-1.66), orig5=q (-1.57), orig2=k (-1.45).
